name: 大智慧金融数据查询
description_zh: 查询股票、ETF、行业等多维金融数据，自动整合行情、财务、资金、公告等信息，适用于快速查数、分析底稿与数据核对。
description_en: Queries multi-dimensional financial data for stocks, ETFs, sectors, and more. Automatically integrates market data, financials, capital flows, announcements, and other information. Suitable for quick data retrieval, analytical worksheets, and data verification.
